uhc.text: A diabetes test (hemoglobin A1c) billed to UnitedHealthcare commercial plans ranges from $5.83 to $16.99 across 29 hospitals. Most prices fall between $8.16 and $16.99, while the highest price is 2.9 times the lowest.

bcbs_az.text: Diabetes test (hemoglobin A1c) prices for Blue Cross Blue Shield of Arizona commercial plans range from $17.67 to $56.69. The highest price is 3.2 times the lowest price. Most prices fall between $22.76 and $36.67.

aetna.text: Diabetes test (hemoglobin A1c) Aetna commercial (employer or individual) plans. The price range spans from $7.49 to $50.39, and the highest price is 6.7 times the lowest. Most prices fall between $22.09 and $39.99.

cigna.text: Diabetes test (hemoglobin A1c) prices for Cigna commercial (employer or individual) plans range from $7.01 to $118. Most prices fall between $14.90 and $118, with the highest price 16.9 times the lowest.

humana.text: Diabetes test (hemoglobin A1c) prices for Humana commercial (employer or individual) plans range from $32.82 to $34.03. The lowest price of $32.82 was charged at 5 HonorHealth hospitals, and the highest price of $34.03 at 3 Abrazo Health (Tenet) hospitals.

cash.text: Diabetes test (hemoglobin A1c) cash price ranged from $3.95 to $198 across 30 hospitals, with most prices between $6.94 and $177. The highest price was 50.1 times the lowest. Cash was below the typical insured price at 59% of hospitals.
